**

miniM in Tirol

** Discover **miniM**, the enchanting world of **Tirol**’s most famous fairy tale characters, right in the heart of **Innsbruck**! This magical museum invites you to step into a realm where **Hansel and Gretel**, **Snow White**, and other beloved tales come to life. **

An Adventure for All Ages

** Whether you're a child at heart or traveling with little ones, **miniM** offers a whimsical escape. Explore interactive exhibits, climb through storybook scenes, and meet your favorite characters up close. The museum’s playful design makes it a perfect stop for families, sparking imagination and joy. **

Where Stories Come Alive

** Located in the charming **Innsbruck** district of **Wilten**, **miniM** blends education with entertainment. Kids can dress up as their favorite heroes, solve puzzles, and even enjoy a sweet treat at the on-site café—serving delicious **Kaiserschmarrn** and other Austrian specialties. **

Plan Your Visit

** Open year-round, **miniM** is easily accessible by public transport or a short stroll from **Innsbruck**’s city center. Don’t miss the seasonal events, like festive holiday markets or themed workshops, adding extra magic to your visit. **

More Than Just a Museum

** Beyond the exhibits, **miniM** hosts workshops, storytelling sessions, and creative activities. It’s not just a place to visit—it’s an experience that stays with you long after you leave. **

Come Play in Tirol!

** **miniM** is more than a museum; it’s a doorway to a world of wonder. Whether you're exploring **Tirol**’s culture or simply seeking fun, this hidden gem promises unforgettable moments for everyone. **Visit miniM now** and let the adventure begin!
